purpose: Explain the V8 support and weight collapse using consumed artifacts only, without selecting a seed, changing a threshold, opening a phase, or fitting a new proposal.

weight_definitions.soft: For each of all 256 seeds, logmeanexp over loose z0 pairs plus log p(q)-log g(q); parent-P1 failures and no-pair rows have zero weight.
weight_definitions.hard_P2: For each seed, logmeanexp over loose pairs whose halo-index identity passes hard P2, plus the same importance correction.
weight_definitions.recentered_P1: For each seed, logmeanexp over loose pairs whose identical halo-index pair passes all five recentered P1 gates and the massive-halo veto.
weight_definitions.joint: For each seed, logmeanexp over pairs in the hard-P2 and recentered-P1 identity intersection, plus the same importance correction.
weight_definitions.best_pair_sensitivity: Repeat the soft calculation with max pair log likelihood instead of the uniform finite-pair logmeanexp; diagnostic only.

lineage_policy.failure_action: Stop before CF4 mode-release audit and report an integrity failure.

decision.authorize_CF4_mode_release_audit_only_if: All lineage checks pass and the frozen terminal funnel is exactly reproduced.
decision.next_on_pass: Freeze a separate N64-N192 CF4 mode-release audit before calculating any detailed CF4 likelihood diagnostics.
decision.next_on_failure: Stop and repair provenance only; do not reinterpret the science result.
